notes:
- Projects is a new Cleanup category, one row per code project. Abandoned shows projects you have not changed for the time you pick (30 days to a year) with everything an install or a build puts back. Active offers only the build output of projects you work on, never their dependencies. Outdated lists Rust toolchains and Node versions nothing uses.
- Old Claude Code plugin versions show in AI tools. Claude Code keeps every version it updated past; the one installed and any in use are never offered.
- Cargo's unpacked crate sources join the package caches.
- The final check groups project folders by what they cost to get back: Installs again, or Costs a build.
- If a build is running in a project when you clean, that project's folders stay and the result says why.
